headline: Tuesday uphill session done: 8 of 8 reps, on target. Plan stays as already updated today
summary: Done: 82min, 16.4km, load 85 against 105 prescribed, avg HR 151, max 175, RPE 7, feel 2. The load model undercounts treadmill incline intervals by 20-25%, so judge this on reps and RPE. 85 counts as roughly 105-110 of real work, and RPE 7 is right for 2 series of 4x4min uphill. Max HR 175 is the top of the cap with no overshoot, so the HR bands look respected. I don't have a per-rep breakdown, so I can't grade drift rep by rep. Readiness this morning: HRV 69 (up from 57), RHR 48 (back down from 53 on Monday), sleep 5.9h. That isn't amber (amber starts under 5.5h), but it's 0.1h short of green, so sleep is still the thing to watch. CTL 54.0, ATL 62.3, TSB -8.3. Today's earlier update already set the rest of Week 7 (610) and race week, aiming for a start-line CTL of about 55.8 and race-morning TSB of +2.6. Nothing in today's session changes that, so no edits. Tomorrow: run 60min at 142-152bpm plus 6 strides, then 50min PM spin at 134-147bpm. If tonight's sleep is under 6h, drop the spin.
flags: Easy-day drift: Fri 23 Oct averaged 155bpm against a 138-148 band. On Wed's 60min, 152bpm is a hard ceiling. If HR goes above 155 on the flat, slow down.
Sleep 5.9h. Two more short nights before Sat 31 would put the last long run behind the Wed and Thu spins: protect bedtime, not the bike.
Cadence 168 spm today. The Thu tempo asks for 170+, so set a cadence alert.
